quotes.quote: Every little action of the common day makes or unmakes character.
quotes.author: Oscar Wilde

quotes.quote: When what you hear and what you see don't match, trust your eyes.
quotes.author: Dale Renton

quotes.quote: It's the best, Jerry, the best!
quotes.author: Bania in The Sein

quotes.quote: Give people a common enemy and you will give them a common identity. Deprive them of an enemy and you will deprive them of the crutch by which they know who they are.
quotes.author: James Alison

quotes.quote: One of the hallmarks of ego is defensiveness. It means that we stand guard at the gates of self, patrolling visitors, VIPs, intruders, everything. This is a very fragile way of living. That means that at any time, any person, anywhere, can do something destructive to my own inner environment. The move away from some of that defensiveness into a certain kind of acceptance, love, deeper understanding, is very important as we evolve ethically.
quotes.author: Matthew Brensilver

quotes.quote: Fear is a natural reaction to moving closer to the truth.
quotes.author: Pema Chodron

quotes.quote: All the water in the world can't sink the ship unless it gets inside.
quotes.author: Zig Ziglar

quotes.quote: The first principle is that you must not fool yourself—and you are the easiest person to fool.
quotes.author: Richard Feynman

quotes.quote: It’s amazing how often a second try works.
quotes.author: Kevin Kelly

quotes.quote: As we express our gratitude, we must never forget that the highest appreciation is not to utter words, but to live by them.
quotes.author: JFK
